meta.title: Session P Strategic Suggestions & Repository Upgrade Proposals (Review Before Implementing)
meta.governance_note: In accordance with review-first safety, Part A proposes concrete repository/dashboard improvements without touching peer workspaces prematurely, while Part B lays out 5 selectable property strategies tuned to live 2026-11-12 data.

repo_upgrades_for_review.title: Replace 404 CAL FIRE FHSZ Citation Across Root & Sibling Workspaces

repo_upgrades_for_review.proposed_fix: Update URL to https://osfm.fire.ca.gov/what-we-do/community-wildfire-preparedness-and-mitigation/fire-hazard-severity-zones (already adopted in Session P S28).

repo_upgrades_for_review.title: Update Root Model & Valuation Anchors from Q4-25 (7.3%) to Q3-26 (6.8% Yield & 4.98% 10Y)
repo_upgrades_for_review.problem: Root tools/model.py still hardcodes Realty Income 7.3% yield and Nov 4-6 4.86%-4.90% Treasury, overstating immediate-sell reinvestment spreads by ~50 bps.
repo_upgrades_for_review.proposed_fix: Parameterize REIT cash yield (default 6.80% Q3-26) and Treasury yield (4.98% Nov 10) in tools/model.py and refresh root valuation tables.
repo_upgrades_for_review.impact: Critical — prevents stale cap-rate arbitrage conclusions on root main.

repo_upgrades_for_review.title: Remediate Factual BLS & Period Errors in session-6d8f5d05 and Enroll It in CI
repo_upgrades_for_review.problem: session-6d8f5d05 is linked at the top of root index.html yet prints wrong Sep 2026 BLS unemployment rates (5.1/4.3/5.6/5.9% vs 4.4/4.0/5.1/4.5%), mislabels Sep 2026 CES payrolls as Q1 2026, and is absent from verify.yml.

repo_upgrades_for_review.title: Fix Whole-Repo Hashing Contention in session-f4f700c0/scripts/audit.py & Clean Root PII Hit
repo_upgrades_for_review.problem: Because audit.py hashes every tracked file across all sessions, merging any PR invalidates subsequent PRs unless re-run post-rebase; additionally research/04-education.md:11 triggers street-address PII regex on the LAUSD headquarters street address on Beaudry.
repo_upgrades_for_review.proposed_fix: Scope audit.py or add CI step documenting post-rebase rebuild; label or replace that LAUSD HQ street address with 'LAUSD District HQ (Downtown LA)'; triage stale open PRs.
repo_upgrades_for_review.impact: High — eliminates multi-PR CI merge conflicts.

property_paths.title: Path 1: Sell Immediately via Targeted IRC §1031 Exchange
property_paths.best_when: Remaining WALT <= 5.5 yrs, Franchisee credit weak, Non-ULA jurisdiction (or going-in cap <= 6.25%), and pre-vetted >= 6.8% replacement assets exist.
property_paths.expected_financial_profile: Preserves 100% of tax-deferred equity; cuts JACK single-tenant/LA earthquake/AB 1228 exposure; immediate Year-1 cash accretion requires exit cap <= 6.59% (Sub-$5.4M) or <= 6.32% (ULA T1), while 6-year NPV (including WALT-cliff & re-tenanting risk) stays accretive up to 8.06% / 7.27%.
property_paths.key_costs_and_risks: 0.56% to 6.06% DTT/ULA + ~3% brokerage/closing; 45-day ID / 180-day close clock; loss of Prop 13 protection.
property_paths.next_action: Obtain 2 BOVs + verify City vs. County jurisdiction + pre-screen 6-8 QI/NNN replacement assets BEFORE listing.

property_paths.title: Path 2: Confidential Blend-and-Extend Then Re-Evaluate Hold vs. Exit
property_paths.best_when: Store sales >= $1.85M AUV, 6-9 yrs left, Measure ULA (4.56%-6.06%) applies, and tenant/corporate willing to sign 10-15 yr term with >= 2.25% escalators.
property_paths.expected_financial_profile: Extending WALT from 6 yrs to 15 yrs typically compresses cap rates by 75-125 bps—creating +12% to +22% equity appreciation that overcomes ULA drag if subsequently sold.
property_paths.key_costs_and_risks: May require temporary rent reset or TI allowance; deepens concentration in JACK unless followed by a sale once extended.
property_paths.next_action: Request store P&L & approach operator quietly with 15-yr extension term sheet requiring corporate/strong guaranty.

property_paths.title: Path 3: Hold Passive Through 2030-2035 & Re-Tenant / Ground Lease
property_paths.best_when: Strong franchisee/corporate guaranty, low Prop 13 basis, near-term estate step-up horizon, OR high exit friction (ULA 6.06% + steep prepayment penalty).
property_paths.expected_financial_profile: Collects contractual NNN cash flow with zero upfront closing drag; retains Prop 13 shield; creates post-2030 re-leasing or ground-lease reset to coffee/dental/QSR.
property_paths.key_costs_and_risks: Must carry 12-month NOI liquidity buffer (~9-18 mos vacancy + $150-$300/sf TI or demolition); exposed to 3.7% inflation vs fixed escalators and JACK downsizing.
property_paths.next_action: Verify existing debt maturity vs. lease expiry, test drive-thru CUP transferability, and confirm full NNN insurance/roof pass-through.

property_paths.title: Path 4: Outright Taxable Sale Into U.S. Treasuries (4.98%-5.35%) & Diversified Equities
property_paths.best_when: Owner holds high tax basis (embedded gain <= 25%-30%), seeks zero real-estate management/45-day pressure, or needs cash liquidity.
property_paths.expected_financial_profile: At 10Y Treasury 4.98% (CA state-tax exempt!) and 30Y 5.35%, low-gain sellers lock in zero credit/quake/retail headaches with full liquidity, though high-gain sellers lose ~28%-35% upfront.
property_paths.key_costs_and_risks: Triggers Federal LTCG (20%) + §1250 (25%) + NIIT (3.8%) + CA 13.30% (made permanent by Nov 2026 Prop 3) + DTT/ULA.
property_paths.next_action: Have CPA calculate exact net-after-tax proceeds before eliminating taxable sale.

property_paths.title: Path 5: Metro D Line TOD / Mixed-Use Land-Value Redevelopment Hold or JV
property_paths.best_when: Parcel lies inside Central LA transit corridor (near newly opened May 2026 Metro D Line stations / TOC / SB-79) where unencumbered land value >= 1.25x leased QSR value.
property_paths.expected_financial_profile: Uses JACK's remaining 2030-2035 NNN rent as paid carrying coverage while entitling multifamily/mixed-use density or selling to an urban developer ahead of LA28.
property_paths.key_costs_and_risks: Entitlement duration (18-36 mos), construction/interest rate risk (4.98% 10Y), and affordable-housing mandates; lease renewal options could block redevelopment unless capped.
property_paths.next_action: Run ZIMAS zoning, TOC tier, and Metro D Line distance audit plus dark/land MAI valuation today.
